queries.query: We have a checkout regression after the tax patch. Give me the smallest safe fix plan with explicit non-goals, minimal verification, and a quick rollback path.
An incident happens only for legacy tenants. I need a plan that limits the change surface to the nearest safe guard and avoids opportunistic cleanup.
Plan the minimal bug fix for a null pointer in invoice export. I want the narrowest change, rollback steps, and only the essential regression checks.
Design the rollout strategy for a new billing feature across staged audiences with monitoring and stop points.
Implement the production code fix for the invoice export null pointer and add tests.
Define in-scope and out-of-scope work for a broader checkout reliability refactor.
